_comment: Look presets for the atmosphere (D164, Tom: 'it's really hard to decide on the settings'). Built-in presets that set only these look settings; quality and performance stay as the player has them. A first proposal for Tom to judge from captures; values can be changed here without code.

presets.name: Clear
presets.description: Crisp, far views, little haze; rays only from the forest canopy when the weather allows.

presets.name: Natural
presets.description: Rays and haze only when the weather makes them (morning, after rain, near water); light and shadow from the land.

presets.name: Atmospheric
presets.description: Hazier air with rays at any time of day; deep, layered distances.

presets.name: Dramatic
presets.description: Strong, contrasty shafts and glow, richer colour: the most cinematic, least subtle.
